name: search_email
description: Search the user's inbox. Returns matching messages, newest first, with id, sender, subject, date and a short snippet.

query.description: Words to look for in the sender, subject or body. Empty returns the whole inbox.

name: read_email
description: Read one message in full by its id.

name: send_email
description: Send an email from the user's account.

in_reply_to.description: Id of the message this replies to, if any.

name: list_events
description: List calendar events that start between two dates (inclusive), as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: create_event
description: Create a calendar event. Times are local, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

name: update_event
description: Change an existing calendar event. Only the fields given change. Times are local, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event by its id.
